info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Operational Services Administration API enables users to manage and update issued device operational services based on specified parameters. Through this API, developers can modify configurations related to banking operational services, ensuring that devices are aligned with organizational requirements. Typical use cases include adjusting service parameters for device management and meeting regulatory compliance, making it a crucial tool for banking institutions. This API is designed for developers working on backend integrations and operational management systems.

patch.description: This endpoint allows the user to update the details of an issued device within the operational services. It is designed for administrators to make changes to device records effectively and ensure that all information is up-to-date.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to update the state or properties of the issued device specified by RES-100045. The content must adhere to the defined schema and include necessary fields to enact the desired changes.

200.description: Request completed successfully, the device details have been updated.
